Codex review: needs changes before merge. _Reviewed May 28, 2026, 9:52 AM ET / 13:52 UTC._

**Summary**
The PR adds AI-generated session titles after a configurable turn threshold, persists them as session metadata, and displays derived titles in the Control UI session list.

PR surface: Source +261, Tests +30. Total +291 across 12 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the PR defects: source inspection shows the new generator lacks the active session model and the helper resolves the default model, while the title precedence change places generated titles ahead of manual display names.

**Review metrics:** 2 noteworthy metrics.
- **Config/default surfaces:** 1 added top-level config object, default-on behavior when omitted. The new `sessionTitle` surface can trigger background model calls and needs maintainer-visible upgrade/privacy agreement before merge.
- **Persisted session metadata:** 1 added SessionEntry field. `autoTitle` is written into the session store, so precedence, migration expectations, and plugin slot ownership matter for existing session data.

**Merge readiness**
Overall: 🧂 unranked krab
Proof: 🐚 platinum hermit
Patch quality: 🧂 unranked krab
Result: blocked by patch quality or review findings.

Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality, so missing proof can cap an otherwise strong patch.

Rank-up moves:
- Honor the active session-selected/runtime model or a documented explicit title model for summarization.
- [P2] Keep manual labels/display names/subjects ahead of generated titles and add regression tests.
- Document and test the `sessionTitle` config/default behavior, including cost/privacy and disablement semantics.

**Mantis proof suggestion**
A short Control UI proof would materially help after the blockers are fixed because the feature is visible in the session list. A maintainer can ask Mantis to capture proof by posting a new PR comment that starts with the OpenClaw Mantis account mention, followed by:

```text
visual task: verify that AI-generated session titles appear in the Control UI session list after the configured turn threshold and manual session names still win.
```

**Risk before merge**
- [P1] Background title generation can send transcript excerpts to the agent default provider instead of the session-selected/current model, which can violate user provider choice and privacy expectations.
- [P1] The feature is effectively default-on when `sessionTitle` is omitted, creating new background model calls, cost, and persisted `autoTitle` writes for existing users unless maintainers explicitly accept that default.
- [P1] Generated titles currently take precedence over manual display names in the server-derived title path, so a user rename can be hidden after auto-title generation.
- [P1] The new `sessionTitle` config surface is accepted by schema but lacks visible config help/docs/default semantics for operators.

**Maintainer options:**
1. **Fix provider routing and manual precedence first (recommended)**  
   Before merge, route title summarization through the active session-selected/runtime model or an explicit documented title model, and keep manual user names ahead of generated titles with regression tests.
2. **Make default-on summarization an explicit maintainer choice**  
   Maintainers can intentionally accept default-on background summarization only after the PR documents cost, privacy, model-selection, and disablement behavior.
3. **Pause in favor of the canonical feature issue**  
   If the default/provider/privacy contract is not ready, keep the implementation paused and continue product/API discussion on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77165.

**Next step before merge**
- [P2] A focused repair can address the concrete provider-routing, manual-precedence, and config-contract blockers, while maintainers still need to approve the default-on product semantics before merge.

**Security**
Needs attention: The diff introduces a concrete provider-routing/privacy concern because transcript snippets can be summarized through the agent default model rather than the active session model.

- [P1] Route title generation through the session model — `src/auto-reply/reply/session-title-generator.ts:90-96`
- [P1] Preserve manual names before generated titles — `src/gateway/session-utils.ts:224-226`
- [P2] Complete the new config contract — `src/config/zod-schema.ts:747-754`
